name: Agricultural Research Portal
persona: A national grains research & development corporation (fictional GRDC-style body)
tagline: A grounded research portal over a body of trials, papers, and transcribed media.
elevatorPitch: An agronomist asks a question in plain English and gets an answer grounded in real trial data with citations — and the portal correctly refuses when the corpus can't support an answer, which is what earns a researcher's trust.

corpus.domain: Australian grains research & development — trials, Update papers, fact sheets, final reports, podcast & webinar transcripts
cornerstoneQueries: How did sowing date interact with variety phenology for Scepter wheat at Merredin?
How do impact mills compare with chaff lining for annual ryegrass seed control?
What yield loss does crown rot cause in the Northern region, and how does inoculum load affect it?
Which lentil variety and plant density performed best at Horsham?
refusalProbes: What were canola export prices from Canada in 2024?
What is the recommended irrigation schedule for rice in the Riverina?
corpus.notes: This blueprint has a fully-built reference corpus already ingested into a live Knowledge Box; it is the factory's end-to-end proof. Multi-modal doc types (podcast/webinar transcripts carry duration + media_type) so the media angle shows.

demoScript.say: Ask a real agronomy question — the answer is grounded in trial data with citations.
demoScript.show: Ask: 'impact mills vs chaff lining for ryegrass' → cited answer, sources grouped by document

demoScript.say: Now watch it refuse. The corpus has no Canadian canola prices, so it declines rather than inventing.
demoScript.show: Ask a refusal probe → explicit ungrounded warning

demoScript.say: Browse the whole corpus by crop, region, topic and media type — counts come live from the Knowledge Box.
demoScript.show: Search facets narrow to Western-region barley

demoScript.say: The graph connects researchers, sites and varieties that recur across documents.
demoScript.show: Graph around a trial site entity

demoScript.say: And every answer carries a groundedness score you can govern against.
demoScript.show: Quality dashboard — ungrounded rate near zero

safety.disclaimer: Demonstration data — synthetic grains research using real Australian districts, varieties and institutions for realism. Not actual research; not agronomic advice.
